questions.question: Compare and contrast grilling and frying in terms of cooking technique / and health impact
questions.solution_html:
• Compare and contrast grilling and frying in terms of cooking technique and health impact.
  • Grilling: Cooks food using dry heat from below. It Enhances flavor; may lose fat-soluble
  • vitamins. Uses minimal oil → lower total calories and fat.
  • Frying: Cooks food by immersing it in hot oil (deep frying) or cooking with a small amount of oil
  • on a pan (shallow frying). Produces a crispy exterior and soft interior; tends to have richer taste
  • due to oil absorption. Adds more calories and fat, raising risk of obesity and heart disease.
  • Definition of cooking methods: (1 mark), Description and health impact: (3 marks)
